title: Chapter 611 - 611 Master; Magic?
content:
Chapter 611 - 611 Master; Magic?

Chapter 611 - 611 Master; Magic?

611 Master; Magic?

After Sam used 400 points of spiritual energy…

Originally, many people wanted to take Lin Fan as their master.

At this moment, the number had multiplied.

Someone even created an online discipleship forum, and the number of members reached millions in a day.

Moreover, as time passed, the number continued to grow.

On the other hand, when Sam Gilbevan’s family saw that their son had obtained 400 points of spiritual power, they rushed to Lin Fan’s house and thanked Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao.

Regarding these…

Lin Fan had no idea.

He looked at Abraham, and his eyes moved slightly.

[Skill Replication: Beginner Sound Wave Technique]

Lin Fan felt his throat itch.

Then, he felt that as long as he moved his mind, he could produce a powerful sound wave.

In fact…

It was also because Abraham had the Begginer Sound Wave Technique that he let out a loud cry when his leg was broken that Lin Fan heard it and rushed over.

Abraham said, “Lin Fan, can I come with you?”

Previously, he felt that he could face all kinds of dangers by himself. Then, he continued to become stronger.

However, after experiencing what had just happened, Abraham understood that he might not be able to withstand the danger.

Lin Fan had a good impression of him. Otherwise, he would not have saved him.

In addition, Sam was already beside him, so it was fine to add another person.

Thus, he nodded and said, “Sure.”

“Thank you!” Abraham said happily.

The three of them and the dog once again set foot on the road ahead.

Beads of sweat rolled down Abraham’s forehead.

His lips were dry and cracked, and his head was a little dizzy.

He looked at Sam and Lin Fan. He asked, “You… Do you guys want to pee?”

Lin Fan shook his head.

Sam said, “If you want to pee, you can pee directly. It won’t be broadcasted live.””

Abraham said, “No… No, I’m just a little thirsty.”

Sam and Lin Fan were stunned.

Therefore, he asked them if they wanted to pee because he wanted to… drink it?

Lin Fan coughed dryly and said, “Actually, we have water.”

Then, he waved his hand and a bottle of mineral water appeared in his hand.

Lin Fan had prepared a lot of water in his internal space. He did not have to worry about drinking at all.

Of course, it did not matter even if they finished it.

Lin Fan had a Advanced Water Control Technique.

He could easily condense the water particles in the air and form an endless amount of water.

Abraham looked at the mineral water in front of him, and his throat became even more dry.

However, he did not immediately grab it. Instead, he said with difficulty, “You… You guys drink first.”

It had to be said that Abraham was a good person.

Even though he was thirsty, he wanted others to drink first.

Lin Fan said, “It’s okay. You can drink. We still have a lot.”

As soon as he finished speaking, his mind moved again.

Then, two new bottles of mineral water appeared in his hands.

Abraham was dumbfounded.

What was going on?

Magic?

He did not care too much about it. He picked up the mineral water and gulped it down to his heart’s content.

Only then did he say, “L-Lin Fan, do you know magic?”

Lin Fan smiled and shook his head. He did not explain further.

As time passed, the scorching sun finally seemed to have burned out the last of its fuel and began to turn yellow and dim.

The sky gradually darkened.

Abraham took out some minced meat from his dirty backpack and said, “Lin Fan, Sam, eat something.”

Even if it was just a bit of minced meat, for people who were walking in the desert, it could save their lives.

At this moment, a large bird that was half the height of a person flew past in the distance with a long shadow.

“The food is here,” Lin Fan said.

As if to confirm Lin Fan’s words, the bird fell from the sky, unable to move anymore.

Sam was already used to this kind of situation.

Therefore, he appeared very calm.

“A bird!” Abraham said excitedly. “A big bird fell from the sky!

“We’re so lucky!

“Unfortunately, there’s no firewood here. I’m afraid we’ll have to eat it raw.”

Even though he was talking about eating it raw, Abraham could not help but swallow his saliva.

As long as he could fill his stomach, eating raw meat was not a problem.

Lin Fan picked up the bird and grabbed it. A knife appeared in his hand.

Soon, the bird’s fur was gone.

Then, Lin Fan willed all sorts of seasonings to appear before him.

He smeared them all over the bird meat.

In the next moment, flames appeared out of thin air under the big bird that had been smeared with seasoning.

Seeing this…

Abraham’s eyes widened, and he stammered, “Fire…Flames… Flames are burning in the air!”

Then, he said in disbelief, “Lin Fan, you really know magic!”

Sam could not stand it anymore and laughed. “This isn’t magic, it’s kung fu! Hua kung fu!”

“Hua kung fu?” Abraham was stunned.

“Yes!” Sam nodded vigorously. “Besides, this is nothing to Master. You’ll know in the future!”

As he spoke, Sam could not help but look fascinated.

At this moment, a rich fragrance spread out from the big bird’s body, and it was very tempting.

Abraham looked at the big golden bird and could not help but swallow.

Lin Fan took the knife and cut a few times before saying, “Yes, almost.”

He first cut a piece of meat and put it into his mouth. He muttered, “Sure enough, it’s better to roast meat with firewood for that smoky smell.”

In fact, this was also the reason why Lin Fan had Sam and the Heavenly Hound collect firewood every day.

Then, Lin Fan said, “You guys eat too.”

“Yes, Master,” Sam said.

As he spoke, he stepped forward and tore a piece of meat.

The Heavenly Hound bit off one of the bird’s legs.

Seeing that everyone was eating, Abraham did not hesitate.

The roasted bird entered Abraham’s mouth, and his mouth was filled with the delicious taste.

He sighed sincerely. “It’s so delicious!”

Then, he took two big bites.

He sighed again. “I can guarantee it! Even the chefs in the top restaurants in Bear Country would never be able to cook such delicious meat!

“It’s so delicious!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took another bite of the roasted meat. The grease and juice spurted out.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing said, “It’s time for the daily eating broadcast again.”

I’m in a Daze With You: [Looking at the white rice in my bowl, I want to say, why wasn’t I chosen? I don’t want Constitution or spiritual energy points. I just want to eat God Lin roasted meat!]

Crescent Moon: [It looks so good!]

Little Painter: [Master, can I eat your roasted meat just once in the future?]

Punch: [Silently drooling.]

…

As more and more people pined for Lin Fan’s roasted meat, someone seemed to have detected a business opportunity. They hurriedly registered the trademark for the names God Lin Barbecue, Lin Fan Barbecue, and so on.
